result:
I added a third peg at the center of the block (x=0, between the pegs at x=±20) and saved the design to `/lab/work/fit.solidcraft`.

I also cut a matching hole in the plate at x=0, because the existing pegs each pass through a plate hole. The new peg is 6 mm across and the new hole is 6.4 mm, the same 0.2 mm gap per side as the other two. I made both changes by adding a circle to the peg sketch (Sketch2) and to the plate sketch (Sketch3), so the existing extrudes picked them up.

The volume changes confirm both features go all the way through. The peg block gained about 141 mm³, which is a 6 mm peg 5 mm tall. The plate lost about 161 mm³, which is a 6.4 mm hole through its full 5 mm thickness. All timeline features rebuilt without errors.

I did not measure the gap itself. I also did not run the lab's own gap check, only the volume check.
